name: morfeusz/light-manager
description: Menadżer plików w terminalu — cała klatka ekranu rysowana przez Imagick i wypychana protokołem Sixel.

suggest.ext-glfw: Windowed mode (--window): a native window with an OpenGL context via PHP-GLFW (https://phpgl.net), and music playback in the audio module (GL\Audio, no window needed). Terminal modes and the rest of the application work without it.
suggest.ext-curl: Docker module (Ctrl+O): talks to the daemon over the /var/run/docker.sock unix socket, non-blocking, via curl_multi. Without it the module is rejected at startup and the rest of the application works unchanged.
